results.title: The Man behind the Portuguese National Anthem
results.description: While millions around the world recognise the stirring melodies of "A Portuguesa," fewer know the multi-talented creative genius behind the music: Alfredo Keil.

results.title: Trigger Point's Vicky McClure teases Shetland star's new role in S4 of the ITV thriller
Runaways Got Morgan le Fay's Neuroscience Right; Dark Patterns and Brane Physics Too
results.description: Morgan le Fay Runaways Season 3 villain Elizabeth Hurley wields three supernatural powers that each correspond to a real scientific discipline: the temporoparietal junction neuroscience of out-of-body experiences, the dopamine-circuit psychology of dark patterns, and extra-dimensional brane-world physics. The show's magic turns out to be surprisingly accurate science.
